questions.question: Chromatography is used in Chemistry to

answers.a: identify the solvent in a mixture.
answers.b: measure the viscosity of a solution
answers.d: measure the density of the components in a mixture

questions.question: In the thin layer chromatography of ink experiment, the purpose of the stationary phase is to

answers.c: give different colors to different species

questions.question: 3. How does chromatography separate components in a mixture?

answers.b: By attracting all components to the mobile phase.
answers.c: By exploiting differences in polarity between components.

questions.question: 4. What is the significance of the R<sub>f </sub> value in TLC?

answers.a: To calculate the density of the solvent.
answers.c: To quantify the amount of stationary phase.
answers.d: To identify and compare components in a mixture.

questions.question: The consequence of using a solvent whose polarity is much greater than the polarity of the components is

answers.d: A poor separation of components due to all of them moving together
